title: MiniSlate quick-lane switcher: compact workspace & route strip prototype
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: The current left rail grows deep and noisy as we add more top-level surfaces (Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost, Models, Deployments). This increases context switching friction for engineers and PMs who routinely jump between a small set of routes across multiple workspaces. Goals: 1) Create a compact, persistent ‘MiniSlate’ quick-lane strip near the top-left that surfaces the 4–6 most relevant routes and the active workspace selector. 2) Reduce the time to switch context (<2 clicks or single keystroke), while keeping the full left rail available for discovery. 3) Preserve role-aware visibility and auditability for Private/Dedicated customers. Scope: low-fidelity sketch -> high-fidelity Figma prototype -> interactive Clickable prototype for usability testing. Deliverables: Figma screens (compact, expanded, keyboard focus states), annotated handoff doc (ARIA roles, animation budget, CSS tokens), engineering acceptance checklist, test script for moderated usability sessions. Constraints & trade-offs: - Prioritize discoverability of cost & rollout flows while avoiding top-level overcrowding. - MiniSlate must be responsive: collapse to an overflow menu on narrow viewports. - Avoid duplicating navigation semantics (MiniSlate mirrors routes, not replace left rail). - Performance: animations must remain <120ms interaction latency on typical customer machines. - Security: MiniSlate must respect RBAC and per-workspace visibility; for Private deployments the control-plane feature flags may hide certain quick lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype: MiniSlate compact + expanded + overflow states published in team file
Clickable prototype with keyboard nav and screen-reader labels available for usability testing
Design spec includes ARIA roles, focus order, reduced-motion variants, and motion timings
Engineering handoff checklist itemized (tokens, variants, responsive breakpoints) and acknowledged by ENG owner
Usability test (n=6) tasks: switch workspace, open Rollouts, open Cost Insights; >=80% success rate and median completion <= 12s
Performance budget: initial MiniSlate render on simulated low-end device < 50ms; hover/expand animation <= 120ms
Visibility rules documented for Dedicated/Private (RBAC mapping) and sample API responses listed in spec
Telemetry hooks identified for switch events (workspace_change, quicklane_open, quicklane_select)
